name: pad occupancy time
definition: Aggregated approach and landing pad occupation

name: gate turnaround time
definition: Time at gate including charging or passenger process

name: passenger load factor
definition: Occupied seats divided by available seats
notes: Preis 2023 baseline; must not be treated as observed demand.

name: counter check-in share
definition: Share of passengers using staffed counter

name: charging power
definition: Charging power available to an eVTOL

name: gate service time
definition: Aircraft gate sequence including charge passenger process and buffer

name: TLOF movement time
definition: Time assigned to one TLOF movement
